1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<script>
(()=>{
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const ui={wave:document.getElementById('wave'),kills:document.getElementById('kills'),time:document.getElementById('time'),healthText:document.getElementById('healthText'),healthBar:document.getElementById('healthBar'),ammoText:document.getElementById('ammoText'),ammoBar:document.getElementById('ammoBar'),status:document.getElementById('status'),start:document.getElementById('startOverlay'),end:document.getElementById('endOverlay'),pause:document.getElementById('pauseOverlay')};
const WORLD={w:2200,h:1600};let viewW=960,viewH=600,dpr=1,last=0,elapsed=0,gameOn=false,paused=false,over=false,spawnClock=0,wave=0,kills=0,screenShake=0;
const keys={},obstacles=[],decor=[],bullets=[],zombies=[],particles=[],drops=[];
const player={x:WORLD.w/2,y:WORLD.h/2,r:15,speed:225,hp:100,maxHp:100,ammo:12,mag:12,reload:0,shot:0,angle:0,invuln:0};
let mouse={x:0,y:0,down:false},touch={active:false,id:null,x:0,y:0,dx:0,dy:0,shoot:false};
function resize(){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(rect.width*dpr));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(rect.height*dpr));viewW=rect.width;viewH=rect.height;}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);resize();
function rand(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a)}
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
function dist(a,b){return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)}
function circleRect(x,y,r,o){const nx=clamp(x,o.x,o.x+o.w),ny=clamp(y,o.y,o.y+o.h);return (x-nx)**2+(y-ny)**2<r*r}
function blocked(x,y,r){return obstacles.some(o=>circleRect(x,y,r,o))}
function moveEntity(e,dx,dy,r){let nx=e.x+dx;if(!blocked(nx,e.y,r))e.x=nx;let ny=e.y+dy;if(!blocked(e.x,ny,r))e.y=ny;e.x=clamp(e.x,r,WORLD.w-r);e.y=clamp(e.y,r,WORLD.h-r)}
function buildWorld(){obstacles.length=decor.length=0;for(let i=0;i<34;i++){const w=rand(75,150),h=rand(75,130),x=rand(35,WORLD.w-w-35),y=rand(35,WORLD.h-h-35);if(Math.hypot(x+w/2-WORLD.w/2,y+h/2-WORLD.h/2)<240)continue;obstacles.push({x,y,w,h,type:Math.random()<.58?'building':'wreck'});}
for(let i=0;i<100;i++){const x=rand(25,WORLD.w-25),y=rand(25,WORLD.h-25);if(!obstacles.some(o=>x>o.x-24&&x<o.x+o.w+24&&y>o.y-24&&y<o.y+o.h+24))decor.push({x,y,type:Math.random()<.55?'grass':'crack',s:rand(3,10),rot:rand(0,6)});}}
function reset(){elapsed=0;wave=0;kills=0;spawnClock=1;player.x=WORLD.w/2;player.y=WORLD.h/2;player.hp=100;player.ammo=12;player.reload=0;player.shot=0;player.invuln=0;bullets.length=zombies.length=particles.length=drops.length=0;over=paused=false;ui.end.classList.add('hidden');ui.pause.classList.add('hidden');ui.start.classList.add('hidden');gameOn=true;ui.status.textContent='SOBREVIVÊNCIA EM ANDAMENTO';last=performance.now();}
function start(){reset();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click',start);document.getElementById('restartBtn').addEventListener('click',start);document.getElementById('resumeBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{paused=false;ui.pause.classList.add('hidden');last=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(loop)});
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const k=e.key.toLowerCase();keys[k]=true;if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();if(k==='r'&&gameOn&&!over)reload();if(k==='p'&&gameOn&&!over)togglePause();if(k==='escape'&&gameOn&&!over)togglePause()});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false);
function togglePause(){paused=!paused;ui.pause.classList.toggle('hidden',!paused);if(!paused){last=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}}
function pointerPos(e){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();return{x:e.clientX-r.left,y:e.clientY-r.top}}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{const p=pointerPos(e);if(e.pointerType==='touch'){canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);if(p.x<viewW*.48){touch.active=true;touch.id=e.pointerId;touch.x=p.x;touch.y=p.y;touch.dx=touch.dy=0}else{touch.shoot=true;touch.id=e.pointerId;aimAt(p.x,p.y);fire()}}else{mouse.down=true;aimAt(p.x,p.y);fire()}});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const p=pointerPos(e);if(e.pointerType==='touch'&&touch.active&&touch.id===e.pointerId){touch.dx=clamp((p.x-touch.x)/48,-1,1);touch.dy=clamp((p.y-touch.y)/48,-1,1)}else if(e.pointerType==='touch'&&touch.shoot){aimAt(p.x,p.y);fire()}else{mouse.x=p.x;mouse.y=p.y;if(mouse.down){aimAt(p.x,p.y);fire()}}});
function endPointer(e){if(e.pointerType==='touch'){if(touch.id===e.pointerId){touch.active=false;touch.shoot=false;touch.dx=touch.dy=0;touch.id=null}}else mouse.down=false}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',endPointer);canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',endPointer);canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
function camera(){return{x:clamp(player.x-viewW/2,0,WORLD.w-viewW),y:clamp(player.y-viewH/2,0,WORLD.h-viewH)}}
function aimAt(sx,sy){const c=camera();player.angle=Math.atan2(sy-viewH/2,sx-viewW/2)}
function reload(){if(player.reload<=0&&player.ammo<player.mag){player.reload=1.1;ui.status.textContent='RECARREGANDO…'}}
function fire(){if(!gameOn||paused||over)return;if(player.reload>0||player.shot>0)return;if(player.ammo<=0){reload();return}player.ammo--;player.shot=.22;const a=player.angle+rand(-.035,.035);bullets.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*22,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*22,vx:Math.cos(a)*760,vy:Math.sin(a)*760,life:.85});particles.push({x:player.x+Math.cos(a)*23,y:player.y+Math.sin(a)*23,vx:Math.cos(a)*65,vy:Math.sin(a)*65,life:.09,max:.09,color:'#ffe29a',size:5});}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D zombie game in Portuguese, continuing and finishing the in-progress implementation.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Jogo de zumbi 2D” and later “Continue where you left off and finish the game.”
- Build request says not to ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML5 Canvas game named **Zumbiss — Última Noite**, with keyboard/mouse and mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive game interface and canvas rendering in `index.html`.
- Added player movement, aiming/shooting, reload, zombie waves, health/ammo pickups, pause/game-over overlays, and HUD.

### Active
- Finish and verify the game implementation; the HTML currently appears to end with a closed script and document, but no browser or syntax validation has been run.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and validate `index.html` JavaScript for syntax/runtime issues, then fix any gameplay bugs.
2. Test the playable flow, including start, movement, shooting, reload, pause, defeat, and restart.
3. Briefly report completion and assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the full game UI, styling, and JavaScript implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The user’s request remains unanswered with a final completion report.

content.text:
Concluí o **Zumbiss — Última Noite** em `index.html`. O jogo tem ondas de zumbis, movimento e mira, tiros, recarga, itens de vida e munição, pausa, derrota e reinício, com controles de teclado, mouse e toque.

Também corrigi o loop de pausa para retomar corretamente e evitar animação contínua após o fim do jogo. Validei a sintaxe do JavaScript e executei `git diff --check`. Não fiz um teste visual em navegador.

**Premissa:** mantive o formato de jogo de sobrevivência sem fim, com dificuldade crescente.
